description: Chatbase lets teams build and operate AI agents trained on their own business content, and run support end to end — chat widgets, help-desk tickets, and the sources those agents are trained on. This connector gives an MCP client direct access to a connected Chatbase account: list and inspect agents, create and update knowledge sources, update agent configuration, export conversations, and read, create, and update help-desk tickets and their messages.

defaultPrompt: Add our new refund policy to the support agent
Show me every support ticket still waiting on a reply
